prompt: Write a GBP post targeted at the Cypress TX service area. Focus on something a Cypress homeowner would care about right now — use real data to pick the angle, not a generic template.

assertions.text: A draft .md file is written to 04-gmb/posts/drafts/
First line of post body contains an AC/HVAC keyword + 'Cypress'
Post body is between 1200 and 1450 characters
Phone number (713) 598-2737 does NOT appear in the post body
Research notes show GSC data was checked for Cypress-related queries
CTA URL points to a Cypress-specific page or the most relevant Houston landing page
No em dashes (—) appear in the post body
No banned AI-slop phrases (ensure, seamless, top-notch, look no further, etc.)
